codes.name: lexical_error
codes.summary: Unexpected character, unknown string escape, or unterminated string literal.
codes.fix: Check the highlighted characters; close strings on the same line; supported escapes: \n \t \r \0 \\ \".

codes.name: integer_literal_overflow
codes.summary: Integer literal does not fit in the signed 64-bit int type.
codes.fix: Use a smaller literal; the maximum is 9223372036854775807.

codes.name: syntax_error
codes.summary: The parser found a token it did not expect.
codes.fix: Compare the highlighted line with docs/LANGUAGE_SPEC.md; look for a missing brace, colon or comma.

codes.name: expected_expression
codes.summary: An expression was required at this position.
codes.fix: Write a literal, variable, call or parenthesized expression.

codes.name: method_calls_not_supported
codes.summary: Method-call syntax (value.method()) is not part of Lutetium 0.1.
codes.fix: Use free functions for now.

codes.name: if_expression_missing_else
codes.summary: An `if` used as a value (e.g. on the right side of `=`) must have an `else` branch.
codes.fix: Add `else { ... }` or use the statement form.

codes.name: duplicate_definition
codes.summary: Two functions share a name, or a function is named `print` (built-in).
codes.fix: Remove or rename one of the definitions.

codes.name: missing_main
codes.summary: No `main` function was found.
codes.fix: Add `fn main() { ... }` with no parameters.

codes.name: type_mismatch
codes.summary: Initializer, assignment, argument or return value has the wrong type. Only int->float widens implicitly.
codes.fix: Add an explicit conversion or correct the declared type.

codes.name: cannot_infer_return_type
codes.summary: Unannotated return type is conflicting or unresolvable (often recursion).
codes.fix: Annotate the return type, e.g. `-> int`.

codes.name: missing_return
codes.summary: A value-returning function must end with a return statement.
codes.fix: Add `return <value>` as the last statement.

codes.name: unknown_type
codes.summary: A type annotation is not a built-in type.
codes.fix: Use int, float, bool, str or unit.

codes.name: unknown_variable
codes.summary: The variable is not defined in any enclosing scope.
codes.fix: Define it with `let` before use, or fix the spelling.

codes.name: unknown_function
codes.summary: No function with this name exists.
codes.fix: Check the spelling, or define it with `fn`.

codes.name: argument_count_mismatch
codes.summary: Call passes a different number of arguments than the function declares (or print received != 1 argument, or main has parameters).
codes.fix: Match the call site to the definition.

codes.name: assignment_to_immutable
codes.summary: The variable was declared without `mut`.
codes.fix: Declare it with `let mut`.

codes.name: condition_must_be_bool
codes.summary: if/while conditions require type bool; numbers are not truthy in Lutetium.
codes.fix: Write an explicit comparison, e.g. `i < 10`.

codes.name: invalid_operands
codes.summary: The operator is not defined for these operand types.
codes.fix: Use two ints, two floats, or two strings with `+`.

codes.name: duplicate_binding
codes.summary: Two let bindings with the same name in one block.
codes.fix: Rename one variable or remove the earlier binding.

codes.name: break_outside_loop
codes.summary: `break` used outside of a while loop.
codes.fix: Move the break into a loop body.

codes.name: continue_outside_loop
codes.summary: `continue` used outside of a while loop.
codes.fix: Move the continue into a loop body.

codes.name: return_outside_function
codes.summary: `return` used in top-level (implicit entry) code.
codes.fix: Move the return into a function; top-level statements run before `main`.

codes.name: unknown_method
codes.summary: Method calls are only defined for the built-in list/string/map methods.
codes.fix: Use `len`, `push`, `pop`, `get`, `set` on lists or `len`, `upper`, `lower`, `trim`, `contains`, `replace`, `split` on strings or `len`, `get`, `set` on maps.

codes.name: map_literal_too_large
codes.summary: A map literal may have at most 127 `key: value` entries.
codes.fix: Split the literal across several maps, or build larger maps with `set` in a loop.

codes.name: invalid_bytecode_file
codes.summary: Bad magic, unsupported version, invalid UTF-8, or broken constant/function table.
codes.fix: Rebuild from source with `lutetium build`.

codes.name: bytecode_verification_failed
codes.summary: Unknown opcode, out-of-range operand, arity mismatch, register read before write, or control flow off the end.
codes.fix: Recompile from source; hand-written bytecode must conform to docs/BYTECODE_FORMAT.md.

codes.name: truncated_bytecode
codes.summary: The file ends mid-value or mid-instruction.
codes.fix: Rebuild the module from source.

codes.name: call_stack_overflow
codes.summary: Recursion exceeded 1024 frames.
codes.fix: Reduce recursion depth or iterate.

codes.name: integer_division_by_zero
codes.summary: Right operand of `/` or `%` on ints was zero.
codes.fix: Check the divisor before dividing.

codes.name: corrupted_bytecode_runtime
codes.summary: Invalid opcode or wrong constant kind at runtime (verified modules cannot trigger this).
codes.fix: Recompile from source.

codes.name: runtime_type_error
codes.summary: Instruction received an unexpected value type (e.g. uninitialized register).
codes.fix: Recompile from source; report it if the source type-checked.

codes.name: integer_overflow
codes.summary: Int arithmetic overflowed the 64-bit signed range; Lutetium never wraps silently.
codes.fix: Use smaller operands or floats.

codes.name: native_backend_unavailable
codes.summary: The Cranelift native backend is planned for milestone 2.
codes.fix: Use `--target bytecode` for now.
